deployed_payloads_in_flight.note: These are the payload hashes the RUNNING containers are bound to, baked into the image deployed at spawn time. The repo's 1k contracts have since moved (resume_in_place was added for the parked perindopril recovery), so the files on disk no longer hash to these. Recorded rather than re-pinned: re-pinning to match a running job would be a fiction in the other direction.
deployed_payloads_in_flight.redeploy_blocked_until: celecoxib 1k completes -- a redeploy could strand these arms on a preemption retry, and that would cost the primary result

resumes.note: Preemption mid-round-33; Modal's retry was refused by the extension guard, which cannot tell a live container from a preempted one. Resumed on the SAME deployed payload arm A ran under, so calls 251-1000 stay on identical code in both arms.
